limitations: A has not produced new calibrated candidate-usability decisions; B assumes conditional source use for a solver experiment
All images and P2 are historical development material, not independent confirmatory data
The B comparison isolates components of a local solver; it is not a full reproduction of strong published systems
Parameter bounds do not certify the extracted surface, currentness, or calibrated metric accuracy
Independent plane-hit expected depth can mix multiple valid surfaces; shared tile culling and center-depth ordering remain
Reference datum, epoch, completeness and absolute accuracy are not fully calibrated; NN sampling is not surface area
Cell-median height detail diagnostics are affected by sampling, mixed layers and reference noise
No Roofer, LoD2, semantic textured-mesh pass or scientific verdict is inferred
